visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A human hand with a black tattoo on the wrist holds a black and silver Fujifilm X100VI digital camera. The hand rotates the camera to display the lens, top manual dials, and the rear LCD screen displaying a live feed. The setting is a brightly lit indoor residential hallway with light wood flooring and storage shelves in the background. A red and white circular logo is constantly overlaid at the top center of the frame. (2) A montage of different cats begins in various indoor domestic settings. An orange tabby cat lies resting on a white plastic storage bin. A white cat with dark spots stands on its hind legs looking out a large window toward a city skyline, then moves to a tall wooden cat tree. A brown tabby cat leans in for a close-up of its face and eyes. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (3) The cats are seen interacting with their environment. A tabby cat vigorously uses its claws on a tall sisal scratching post. Multiple cats sit on different levels of a cat tree near a balcony door. Three cats congregate at the threshold of a doorway leading to a balcony, with their forms reflected clearly on the polished floor tiles. The setting is a clean, modern pet-friendly home. (4) The cats engage in playful and routine activities. A white cat rolls onto its back on the floor, paws in the air. A tabby cat eats dry food scattered on the tile floor. Cats are shown moving between rooms and sitting on window sills behind insect screens. The camera uses close-ups and medium shots to capture the cats' movements and expressions. The top logo remains throughout.
